**BLUF:** In the core area, Buchanan County authorities secured two consecutive life sentences for Dustin Owens in the 2022 murder of his pregnant girlfriend Amber Compton and their unborn child. Bluefield, WV, issued a holiday scam warning tied to its Holiday of Lights event and confirmed the event will remain free but donation-based this year. No active NWS alerts or major incidents reported in Tazewell County or immediate neighbors; mild weather with highs near 66°F expected. In the broader region, Virginia State Police seized over $450,000 in illegal drugs statewide last week, while several fatal crashes and a school bomb threat occurred in southern West Virginia counties.[[1]](https://wcyb.com/news/local/judge-sentences-man-who-murdered-pregnant-girlfriend-and-unborn-child-to-2-life-sentences)[[2]](https://www.1stheadlines.com/from/552)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Core:** Buchanan County (Grundy, VA) — On November 20, 2026, Judge Reece Hale Robertson sentenced Dustin Owens to two consecutive life sentences for the first-degree murder of his 7-month-pregnant girlfriend Amber Compton and their unborn daughter Amelia Elizabeth in October 2022. Owens was convicted earlier in 2026 following a nine-day trial. Buchanan County Commonwealth’s Attorney Nikki Stiltner stated the sentence reflects the brutality of the crimes.[[1]](https://wcyb.com/news/local/judge-sentences-man-who-murdered-pregnant-girlfriend-and-unborn-child-to-2-life-sentences)

**Region:** Virginia State Police — Over $450,000 worth of illegal drugs were seized across Virginia in one week as part of ongoing crime suppression operations (reported November 20, 2026).[[2]](https://www.1stheadlines.com/from/552)

Nothing else reported in the last 24 hours for Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office, Richlands/Tazewell/Bluefield VA or WV police, Mercer County Sheriff, or WV State Police (Princeton).

Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

Bristol District (VDOT) weekly traffic alert covers November 23–29, 2026 (details via VDOT site). No major interstate or primary road closures reported on US-19, US-460, I-77, or I-81 in the immediate area.

**Region:** Russell County, VA — Video shows a truck nearly hitting a child boarding a school bus (November 19, 2026).[[4]](https://therealwv.com/2026/11/17/bluefield-state-goes-1-1-in-atlantic-region-challenge/)

Mercer County, WV — Comedian Jamie Lissow scheduled to perform (November 20, 2026 report).[[6]](https://www.wusa9.com/article/news/local/virginia/virginia-man-sentenced-12-years-prison-killing-pregnant-girlfriend/65-be81704b-1945-42d1-a32b-ae716acb84e5)
